conditions.braking: After full-throttle acceleration, request throttle 0 and brake 1 through existing actuator rates; stop below 0.1 m/s or after 30 s. No reaction-time delay.
conditions.braking100: A fresh vehicle starts rolling at exactly 100 km/h with controls initially released and the standard initial gear and engine state; request throttle 0 and brake 1 through existing actuator rates.
conditions.restart: Full throttle for 8 s after the acceleration-run braking stop.
conditions.cornering: Fresh vehicle at 25 m/s; 12 s, throttle 0.3, steering 0.25*sin(time), front steering rule 0.8.
conditions.aids: Unchanged automatic shifts, launch assistance, wheel-slip and pitch protection; fixed authored mass.
conditions.settledCriterion: Final 10 s range below 0.1 km/h and every 1 s acceleration sample below 0.01 m/s² in magnitude.
